headline: A 2016 executive order sets out a federal government approach to preventing and responding to mass atrocities.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order lays out a broad federal approach to preventing atrocities, such as large-scale violence against civilians, and responding when they happen. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, offices, or duties it creates cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order likely directs federal agencies to take part in efforts to prevent and respond to atrocities, though the details are not given in the material provided.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 18, 2016; no separate start date was given in the material provided.
